results.title: From fantasy to spoken word: Professor invents languages with AI
results.description: The University of Miami has just released a new AI tool that can generate new languages — like Klingon from Star Trek — and its inventors say this technology could help endangered ones.

results.title: ARX validates GEREON during allied Army experiment
results.description: ARX deployed eight GEREON robots during a multinational Army experiment. The month-long exercise tested sensor payloads, allied communications, logistics, casualty evacuation, and field charging in demanding desert conditions. The post ARX validates GEREON during allied Army experiment appeared first on Industrial News .
